Companion Animal Travel Desk: Planning Animal Travel

Welcome to the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways. This guide helps travelers prepare pets for a calm and orderly trip through our skyport procedures.

Before travel, make sure the carrier is sturdy, clean, and large enough for the animal to turn, stand, and rest without strain. Keep familiar bedding inside when possible, and secure any food or water items so they do not spill during handling. Our team uses calm, humane methods around animals, and travelers should do the same when moving through the terminal.

If your animal needs a quarantine stop, follow the direction given by the senior coordinator and present the required travel records at check-in. <<FACT F028>> Staff will confirm the next step after review, and travelers should wait for guidance before moving the kennel or carrier.

For animals using the pet relief area, keep the leash short and remain with the pet at all times. <<FACT F013>> Clean up after the animal, close the area securely, and return to the departure path without delay. If your pet is anxious, speak softly and allow a brief pause before rejoining the main flow of passengers.

If you are connecting to another Aurelia Skyways service, check your documents, keep the animal comfortable, and stay alert for staff directions at each transfer point. A calm routine helps the journey stay smooth for both the traveler and the pet.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before your departure or speak with the senior coordinator at the skyport.
